title: Inductive iris in WR-90: 2 mm thick, 12 mm wide, centred
source: Mode matching of TE_m0 modes at the iris' two junctions, cascaded as generalised scattering matrices (A. Wexler, IEEE Trans. MTT 15(9):508–517, 1967; J. Uher, J. Bornemann, U. Rosenberg, Waveguide Components for Antenna Feed Systems: Theory and CAD, Artech House 1993), converged with 640 modes in the guide (changes below 1e-4 from 320)

quantities.reason: second-order elements of 4 mm graded to 1 mm at the iris' edges, where E ∝ r^{-1/3}: the S-parameters converge as h^{4/3} there (complex error 6.6e-3 measured)
as |S11|: the edge singularity shifts the iris' susceptance slightly
as |S11|; power is conserved to rounding

quantities.quantity: largest |S − S_mm| over 9, 10 and 11 GHz (S11 and S21, complex)
quantities.reason: measured about 7e-3 against 320-mode matching; halving the size lowers it as h^{4/3}
